description: A recorded-style session used only by scripts/capture-screenshots.js. Explicit references were produced by running bibleExtractor and bibleDb over these transcript lines; paraphrase cards are the LM Studio results for the same lines. Times are milliseconds after Listen.

events.text: Good morning, church. Today we're going to look at one of the most beloved passages in all of scripture.
John 3:16 tells us that God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son.

card.text: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.

events.text: That is the gospel in one sentence. And you know, David wrote that the Lord is his shepherd,
and he shall not want. He leads him beside the still waters and restores his soul.

card.text: The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want. He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters. He restoreth my soul: he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.

events.text: Brothers and sisters, God is not finished with us. Romans 8:28 says that all things work together

card.text: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.

events.text: for good to them that love God. And his peace, the peace that passes all understanding, will keep your hearts and minds.

card.text: And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.

events.text: I want to remind you of Isaiah 40 verse 31. They that wait upon the Lord shall renew their strength.

card.text: But they that wait upon the Lord shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.

events.text: They shall mount up with wings as eagles. Jesus is the way, and the truth, and the life.

card.text: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.

events.text: So trust him with all your heart, and do not lean on your own understanding.

card.text: Trust in the Lord with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding. In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.

cards.text: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.
